name: Signup phone verification (SMS OTP) — approval frames
description: FFRNT-361: SMS phone verification as a step of account registration. Freezes where the step sits in signup (immediately after POST /signup issues a session, before the approved check-inbox screen, in parallel with email verification), the enter-phone → sending → enter-code → verified path, and every state the UI must render: wrong / expired / too-many-attempts (429) codes, send failure, send rate-limit, SMS channel unavailable (honest degrade, never a dead end), number can't be used (409 only after a correct code — no enumeration), server-rejected number, both skip-policy outcomes, loading, already-verified, resume-after-reload, session expired and generic error — at desktop and 375px. Approving the flow approves the build inventory below and the listed contract deltas. frontend-test-engineer drives Playwright against the data-frame / data-* hooks.

notes: mfa-stepup-mobile/03-confirm-contact.html (flow confirm-contact-phone, approved: false) is the post-signup/settings phone OTP screen. This feature is the SIGNUP context of the same screen: same data-panel='confirm-contact', same state names (enter-phone, sending, enter-code, error-invalid, error-send, verified) and action names (send-code, verify-contact, resend, skip), plus data-context='signup' and the states that frame is missing (error-expired, error-locked/429, error-rate-limited, error-unavailable, error-number-unavailable, loading, already-verified, resumed, error-session, error-generic). OtpInput geometry is identical (42x52 cells, >=44px tap target). Implementation must be ONE ContactVerifyPanel + state machine used in both contexts, not a parallel component tree. If this feature is approved first, confirm-contact-phone should adopt these states on its next iteration.

auth-experience (signup, verify-email approved) is NOT edited. 01-signup, 03-check-inbox and 04-verify-landing are unchanged; email stays link-click (the same ruling mfa-stepup-mobile recorded). The only change to the approved flow is a flagged routing delta: when this step applies, signup's submit routes to /signup/phone instead of /signup/verify.
After a skip, the reminder surface is the existing 'Unverified' phone chip in account-security / mfa-stepup-mobile 04-security-status; no new reminder surface is introduced.
openQuestionsForOwner: Skip policy default — these frames recommend and assume 'optional'; 'required' is fully designed in 07-skip-policy.html.
May one phone number be shared by more than one account? If yes, the 409 PHONE_UNAVAILABLE state is removed.
Package home of the shared ContactVerifyPanel — assumed @fuzefront/auth-ui, consumed by @fuzefront/account-security-ui for the settings context.

gate-frames-first coverage overlap: auth-experience's APPROVED flows claim packages/auth-ui/src/**, which contains this feature's implementation path, so check-frames-first.mjs ('ONE approved flow claiming this file is enough') would pass this feature's UI before these frames are approved. Fix = narrow auth-experience's implementation.paths (changes its stamp, needs re-approval) or have the gate prefer the most specific claim.

decisions.placement: After POST /v1/security/signup → 201 (session issued) and BEFORE auth-experience 03-check-inbox, in parallel with email verification. Phone verify REQUIRES an authenticated session (requireBearer on /verify/phone/start and /verify/status in backend/security/src/routes/security.ts); signup already establishes one, so the step runs immediately with no extra sign-in. Not after email verification: that is a non-blocking link-click that may complete on another device without a session, and it would make a working SMS step depend on email delivery.
decisions.skipPolicy: Server-driven AuthMethods.verification.phoneAtSignup: off | optional | required (contract delta). Recommended default: optional (Skip visible, reminder in Settings → Security). required removes the user's Skip but never blocks account creation and never dead-ends: service failures (503 SMS_UNAVAILABLE, 429 lockout) defer with Continue and re-prompt at next sign-in.
decisions.noEnumeration: POST /verify/phone/start answers 202 for any well-formed number regardless of other accounts. 409 PHONE_UNAVAILABLE is returned only by /confirm after a CORRECT code, so only someone in possession of the phone can learn the number is unusable, and the copy still does not assert that another account exists.
decisions.honestDegrade: AuthMethods.verification.sms === false (no SMS_SERVICE_URL) → the step is never rendered (routed past). 503 mid-flow → 'Text messages aren't available right now' + Continue. No vendor name anywhere in the UI.
decisions.e164: Client: country calling-code + national number normalised with libphonenumber-js (MIT; adopt, don't hand-roll) and shown as the exact E.164 string sent; Send disabled until valid. Server re-validates (400 PHONE_INVALID).

contract.featureFlagDefault: OFF — target the builders audience (owner + QA synthetic accounts) so prod-smoke and e2e can see it; gate both the route and the signup redirect.
contract.smsAvailabilityAdvertised: Yes — AuthMethods.verification.sms (required), derived from SMS_SERVICE_URL in GET /v1/security/methods.
contract.authRequirement: start + status require a bearer session (requireBearer); confirm currently does NOT (see delta 1). Signup's 201 LoginResponse supplies the session, so the step runs right after signup.
deltas: SECURITY — POST /v1/security/verify/phone/confirm must declare and enforce bearerAuth and bind to the session user. Today the route has no requireBearer, the OpenAPI operation has no `security`, and AuthentikIdentityProvider.confirmPhoneVerification runs users.where({ phone }).update({ phone_verified: true }) — marking EVERY account holding that number verified.

POST /verify/phone/start must not write users.phone before possession is proven (today it updates users.phone then sends). Hold a pending number; promote it on confirm. PhoneVerifyConfirmRequest becomes { code } (phone optional; if supplied it must equal the pending number).
NEW 202 body PhoneVerifyStartAck { maskedPhone: string, expiresInSeconds: integer, resendAfterSeconds: integer } — drives the resend cooldown and expiry countdown instead of client-hard-coded timers.

POST /verify/phone/start error taxonomy: 400 PHONE_INVALID (server-side E.164 + SMS-capable), 429 RATE_LIMITED + Retry-After (per user, per number, per IP — no limiter exists on this route today), 502 SMS_SEND_FAILED, 503 SMS_UNAVAILABLE + Retry-After. Today any transport error falls through sendError to 401 UNKNOWN 'Authentication failed', which a client must read as a lost session.

POST /verify/phone/confirm error taxonomy: 422 CODE_INVALID { attemptsRemaining }, 422 CODE_EXPIRED, 429 TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS + Retry-After, 409 PHONE_UNAVAILABLE (only after a correct code). Today wrong and expired both return 401 NOT_ACTIVE — indistinguishable from session expiry — and HttpNotificationClient.checkSmsOtp maps every non-2xx (incl. sms-service 429) to false. Distinguishing expired/max-attempts needs sms-service /sms/verify to return a status (pending|approved|expired|max_attempts) — a family sms-service change, delegate accordingly.
No-enumeration: POST /verify/phone/start returns 202 for every well-formed number whether or not it is held by another account; uniqueness is decided only at confirm.
NEW VerificationStatus.phonePending?: { maskedPhone, expiresInSeconds, resendAfterSeconds } — lets a reload resume at enter-code without a second SMS.
Routing (frontend, flagged): when the step applies, auth-experience signup's post-201 navigation targets /signup/phone instead of /signup/verify. No approved frame changes.

externalPackages: libphonenumber-js (MIT) — E.164 parsing/formatting + per-country length validation
designSystemAdditions: OtpInput — 6-cell, paste-aware, arrow/backspace nav, autocomplete=one-time-code on cell 1, 42x52 cells / >=44px target. Already named missing by mfa-management and mfa-stepup-mobile: build ONCE.
PhoneInput / CountryCodeSelect — flag + dial-code select paired with a tel input, >=44px target.
Alert info/warning variants — add if still missing.

frames.label: Index
frames.summary: Flow walker (8 frames in order), frozen decisions, build inventory, contract binding + deltas, reconciliation with mfa-stepup-mobile / auth-experience, open questions.
frames.acceptanceNotes: index links to every frame in order; the build inventory mirrors manifest.build 1:1; reconciliation, deltas and the gate-coverage open question are visible in the page, not only in manifest.json.

frames.label: (01) Where the step sits
frames.summary: Signup → phone → check inbox → verify landing, with the placement rationale and the post-signup routing table (flag/policy off, SMS unavailable, already verified, pending resume, default).
frames.acceptanceNotes: After POST /signup 201 the client routes to /signup/phone ONLY when the flag is ON, phoneAtSignup != off, verification.sms is true and phoneVerified is false; otherwise straight to /signup/verify. phonePending resumes at enter-code. Email verification proceeds independently and may complete first.

frames.label: (02) Enter phone
frames.summary: PhoneNumberField (country calling code + national number → E.164 preview) at desktop and 375px: idle, client-invalid, valid, and sending (start in flight).
frames.acceptanceNotes: Send code is disabled until libphonenumber-js reports a valid number; the E.164 preview shows the exact string posted to POST /verify/phone/start { phone }. Invalid shows aria-invalid + role=alert on blur/submit, not per keystroke. While sending, inputs + button disable with a spinner so a slow network cannot double-send. Skip is rendered only under policy=optional.

frames.label: (03) Enter code
frames.summary: 6-cell OtpInput (same primitive as mfa-stepup-mobile) with masked number + change-number, paste-aware entry, SMS autofill, expiry countdown, resend cooldown → ready, and verifying (confirm in flight).
frames.acceptanceNotes: Pasting a 6-digit code into ANY cell fills all six (non-digits stripped) and auto-submits. Cell 1 carries autocomplete=one-time-code. Confirm is disabled until 6 digits. Resend is disabled with a live countdown for resendAfterSeconds (Δ start ack), then enabled; resending clears the cells and restarts both timers. While verifying, cells/Confirm/Resend are disabled — no double submit. Change number returns to enter-phone with the number prefilled.

frames.label: (04) Verified → continue
frames.summary: Server-confirmed success (masked number) with the email-next hint and Continue to auth-experience 03-check-inbox; progress rail marks Phone done.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Rendered only after POST /verify/phone/confirm 200 with phoneVerified: true — never optimistically. Continue routes to /signup/verify, or straight into the app when verification.email is false.

frames.label: (05) Code errors
frames.summary: Wrong code (server-reported attempts remaining), expired code (send a new code), too many attempts / 429 with Retry-After countdown and a Continue-for-now exit.
frames.acceptanceNotes: All fail closed and stay on screen — no navigation, no verified state. 422 CODE_INVALID: cells error, focus cell 1, attemptsRemaining from the server. 422 CODE_EXPIRED (or client expiry reaching 0:00): cells disabled, only 'Send a new code'. 429 TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: live Retry-After countdown, Continue-for-now (continue-without-phone) under both policies — never a dead end.

frames.label: (06) Send & channel errors
frames.summary: SMS channel unavailable (503 honest degrade, desktop + 375), send failed (502), send rate-limited (429, 'I already have a code'), number can't be used (409 after a correct code — no enumeration), server-rejected number (400).
frames.acceptanceNotes: Every state offers a way forward. 503 SMS_UNAVAILABLE → Continue (both policies). 502 → Try again / different number / skip. 429 RATE_LIMITED → Retry-After countdown + return to enter-code. 409 PHONE_UNAVAILABLE comes only from /confirm after a correct code; copy never asserts another account exists. 400 PHONE_INVALID stays on enter-phone with an inline error. No provider/vendor text is ever rendered.

frames.label: (07) Skip policy
frames.summary: Policy matrix (off / optional / required) and both outcomes: optional with Skip + skipped confirmation; required with no Skip + required-but-SMS-unavailable deferral.
frames.acceptanceNotes: policy=optional: Skip rendered (top bar + link button), no confirm dialog, then Continue to check-inbox; rail shows Phone 'later'. policy=required: NO [data-action='skip'] anywhere in the panel or top bar, info note explains why; a service failure still defers via continue-without-phone and re-prompts at next sign-in. policy=off / flag OFF: the route is never rendered.

frames.label: (08) Loading & edge states
frames.summary: Loading skeleton (methods + status in flight, desktop + 375), already verified (auto-advance), resumed after reload (phonePending), SMS-off preflight (step skipped), session expired (401), generic error.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Loading renders a layout-stable skeleton and no Skip until the policy is known. phoneVerified true → auto-advance to /signup/verify. phonePending → resume at enter-code with server cooldown, no new SMS. verification.sms false → route skipped. 401 (true session failure only) → Sign in with ?next=/signup/phone. Network/5xx → Try again (+ Skip under optional); raw server text never shown.
